meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接、脚本或简介变成可发布的产品发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把产品或活动快速做成一支能直接发布的宣传短片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link, script, or brief into a publishable product launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a ready-to-publish promo clip for a product or launch

howto.what: 把产品网址、贴来的脚本或需求简报，走完抓取页面、定设计系统、写分镜与旁白脚本、逐帧搭建，最后输出一支产品发布或宣传视频。
howto.when: 当你想为产品做宣传、发布、推广等，或给出一个商业网址时触发；网站导览/展示类需求也走这里。

say.text: 用 acme.com 做一支产品发布视频
say.note: 会先抓取该网站作为素材来源

say.text: 这段产品脚本帮我做成宣传片

say.text: 把视频时长定为 30 秒
say.note: 分镜时长按这个设定来写

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: it captures the site, sets a design system, writes a storyboard and script, builds each frame, and renders renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or hand over a commercial URL; site tours and showcases route here too.

say_en.text: Make a product launch video from acme.com
say_en.note: It captures that site as the asset source
